nodes.label: An approved Illinois driver-education course includes at least thirty classroom hours and six hours driving a regular passenger vehicle with an instructor.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning classroom plus behind-the-wheel minimums; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An applicant aged fifteen through seventeen needs provider evidence of enrollment in approved driver education or a course starting within thirty days to receive an instruction permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning young permit links to approved education; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For ages fifteen through seventeen, an instruction permit lasts twenty-four months and must be held for nine consecutive months before licensing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit life differs from holding period; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Beginning at seventeen years and three months, an applicant may seek an instruction permit without taking driver education.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning later-teen permit has education exception; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A permit applicant must pass the vision and written examinations for the requested license class, and those results remain valid until the permit expires.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit exams match requested class; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An instruction permit allows behind-the-wheel instruction in the driver-education course.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit supports instructor-led practice; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Other permit practice requires a parent, guardian or responsible adult who is at least twenty-one, holds a valid license and has a year of driving experience, seated beside the learner in front.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning qualified supervisor sits beside learner; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: After finishing driver education, a permit holder may continue practicing under the same direct adult supervision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning course completion does not end supervision; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Before licensing at sixteen, an applicant younger than eighteen must complete fifty supervised practice hours, including ten at night, in addition to driver-education training.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning fifty practice hours include ten nighttime; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Licenses for people younger than twenty-one use a vertical layout with distinguishing features.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning young-driver license is vertical; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An applicant younger than eighteen brings the instruction permit, acceptable identity documents, a properly signed fifty-hour log and any applicable minor-consent affidavit or Cooperative Driver Testing Certificate.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning young applicant brings records and consent; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A young applicant requesting REAL ID must also provide the full first-time REAL ID identity-document set.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning youth pathway keeps real id documents; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: License issuance requires the agency to receive the driver-education completion notice and post it to the applicant’s driving record.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning completion must reach driving record; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A student selected by a birthday-based spot-check date must pass a facility road test even after passing the instructor’s road test.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning spot check can require another road test; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An applicant licensed before the instruction permit expires does not pay an additional license-application fee.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning unexpired permit avoids additional fee; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A high-school student completing accredited classroom and driving instruction with a combined A or B grade may qualify for exemption from the agency’s road test through cooperative testing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning qualifying school performance may waive agency test; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A Cooperative Driver Testing Certificate follows a successful driving examination and needs both the instructor’s signature and the parent’s or guardian’s signature.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning cooperative certificate needs both signatures; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The cooperative-testing certificate expires with the instruction permit, cannot be extended and must be presented when applying for the license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning certificate shares permit expiry; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A dropout younger than eighteen needs a qualifying exception before the education-completion notation can be added: verified alternative-program enrollment, a GED, eight passed courses in the preceding two semesters or the required written consents.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning dropout notation requires listed exception; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The dropout-consent exception requires written consent from the parent or guardian and the regional superintendent.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning dropout consent has two sources; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A local superintendent or chief school administrator may waive dropout conditions considered contrary to the student’s best interest.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning school administrator may waive conditions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A first-time applicant aged eighteen through twenty who has neither a previous license nor approved driver education must complete a six-hour adult driver-education course.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning young adult without prior qualification, six hours; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The adult course must come from an agency-certified provider; classroom or online delivery depends on that provider’s certification, and an uncertified course is not accepted.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning provider certification controls course acceptance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Illinois graduated licensing covers ages fifteen through twenty through three progressive phases, with advancement dependent on driving behavior.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning progression depends on conduct; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: During the permit phase, nighttime restrictions run from ten at night until six in the morning Sunday through Thursday and from eleven at night until six Friday and Saturday, subject to differing local curfews.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit nighttime limits vary by weekday; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The permit phase requires at least nine months and fifty supervised practice hours, including ten after dark, with a licensed parent or adult at least twenty-one.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit phase combines time and practice; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The nine-month permit phase must be free of driving infractions, underage alcohol convictions and court supervision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit phase requires clean conduct; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Permit-phase passengers are limited to one in the front and the number of available safety belts in the rear.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning passenger limit follows seating and belts; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A driver younger than nineteen cannot use a cellphone or wireless device while driving, including hands-free use, except an emergency contact with police, a health-care provider or an emergency-services agency.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning under nineteen, emergency-contact exception only; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For initial license holders aged sixteen or seventeen, nighttime restrictions use ten-to-six Sunday through Thursday and eleven-to-six Friday and Saturday, with local curfews potentially different.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning initial license keeps nighttime restrictions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An initial license holder must keep six conviction-free months before turning eighteen; a conviction in this phase can extend restrictions beyond the eighteenth birthday.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning conviction can extend initial restrictions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Until the earlier of twelve licensed months or age eighteen, only one passenger younger than twenty is allowed unless the passengers are the driver’s siblings, stepsiblings, children or stepchildren.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning first-year young-passenger rule has family exceptions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: After the initial young-passenger period, passengers remain limited to one front-seat occupant and the number of rear safety belts.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning later passenger limit follows seats and belts; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Full licensing at ages eighteen through twenty removes age-based restrictions unless the driver failed to advance out of the initial phase; the under-nineteen wireless restriction still applies.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning full phase retains stated exceptions; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Licensing at sixteen or seventeen requires written parental or guardian consent, and the person who gave it may cancel the license for any reason before the driver turns eighteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning consent giver can cancel minor license; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: After consent is withdrawn, privileges cannot return until that person consents again or the driver turns eighteen, whichever comes first; the driver must reapply, take required exams and pay applicable fees.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning restored consent still requires reapplication; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A parent or guardian can view an under-eighteen permit or graduated-license holder’s driving record free online using the agency-provided personal identification number.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning parent has free minor-record access; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A valid permit holder younger than twenty-one and the parent or guardian can use the permit number online to check whether high-school driver-education completion is recorded.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning permit number checks education posting; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The agency offers a Parent-Teen Driving Guide and a voluntary driving contract to help families set learning expectations and boundaries.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning guide and voluntary contract support practice; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A driver younger than twenty-one is limited to one court supervision for serious traffic offenses and must attend traffic safety school to obtain supervision for a traffic violation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning supervision is limited and requires school; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A driver younger than eighteen seeking court supervision for a traffic violation must appear with a parent or guardian.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning minor supervision needs parent in court; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Court supervision for certain alcohol offenses can postpone a minor’s full graduated license for nine months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning alcohol supervision delays full license; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For a driver younger than twenty-one, at least two moving-violation convictions within twenty-four months lead to a license suspension of at least thirty days, with duration depending on offense seriousness.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning repeated young-driver violations suspend license; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Reinstatement after a young-driver suspension may require remedial driver education, and eligibility for a restricted permit during suspension is not guaranteed.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning remedial course possible, permit not assured; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An under-twenty-one vehicle occupant receiving court supervision for possessing, consuming, buying or receiving alcohol faces a three-month license suspension; conviction brings at least six months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning alcohol sanction distinguishes supervision and conviction; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A permit or initial-phase driver younger than eighteen may have driving privileges suspended for violating the nighttime driving restriction.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning night restriction violation can suspend privileges; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An under-eighteen driver charged after a crash causing serious injury or death may be denied license issuance or renewal even if alcohol was not involved.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning serious crash can block minor licensing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An unresolved court traffic citation can prevent license issuance for someone younger than eighteen.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning pending citation can block issuance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
